    UIContext
    The Context interface for the State Pattern.
    UIEffects
    Utility class providing reusable JavaFX visual effects for UI components.
    UIEvent
    Base marker interface for all asynchronous events handled by the CLI's main Event Loop.
    UIEvent.ActionAcceptedEvent
    Confirms that the server successfully validated and processed the last requested action.
    UIEvent.ActionRejectedEvent
    Indicates that the server denied the last requested action, containing the error reason.
    UIEvent.ClientStateUpdatedEvent
    Signals a macro-phase transition for the client (e.g., moving from LOBBY to IN_GAME).
    UIEvent.GameRestoredEvent
    Triggered when a crashed or disconnected game is successfully recovered and synchronized from server logs.
    UIEvent.GameUpdatedEvent
    Carries the latest, fully updated game state payload received from the server.
    UIEvent.LeaderboardReadyEvent
    Carries the global database leaderboard statistics and the local player's specific ranking index.
    UIEvent.LobbyUpdatedEvent
    Contains the updated list of available matches/lobbies to display in the waiting room.
    UIEvent.LoginErrorEvent
    Signifies a failed login attempt (e.g., nickname already in use or invalid).
    UIEvent.MessageEvent
    Represents a generic informational notification to be displayed to the user (e.g., "Player joined").
    UIEvent.ResolutionTimeoutEvent
    A local background timer event used to transition the screen from the "Game Over" board to the Leaderboard.
    UIEvent.UserInputEvent
    Encapsulates a raw string of text inputted by the user via the terminal.
    UIState
    The core interface for the State Pattern driving the CLI.
    UpdateGameMessage
    Message sent by the server to update the game state for the client.
    View
    Generic interface for managing how the client views the game representation.
    VirtualView
    Generic interface used by the server to communicate with clients without knowing the underlying network implementation.
    VisualTheme
    Centralized theme manager that loads and provides visual assets for the CLI.
    WaitingPlayersState
    Represents the UI state when the local player has successfully joined or created a game, but the match has not yet started because the required number of players hasn't been reached.
    WaitingState
    Represents a passive UI state where the local client is waiting.
